description: Mechanize cam-prune, cam issue get, and the cam-next preflight as deterministic zero-LLM CLI subcommands the orchestrator merely calls and narrates (CAM-197 Layer-1 Slice 2).

userStories.title: Add deterministic `cam prune` subcommand
userStories.description: As the orchestrator, I need a pure `cam prune` CLI subcommand so that the branch-cleanup git dance runs deterministically (zero LLM, no pane) and I only call it and narrate.
acceptanceCriteria: `cam prune` refuses to run and exits nonzero when the working tree is dirty or when the current branch is main, and on a cam/* branch it checks out main, pulls origin main, deletes the branch (git branch -D), and runs git fetch --prune, all driven through injected git deps (no real git shell-out in tests). [oracle: bun test test/commands/prune.test.ts]

Confirmation cases (non-cam/* branch, and an open unmerged PR detected via injected gh dep) STOP with a nonzero exit and a clear message unless `--force` is passed, which bypasses the confirmation; --force never bypasses the dirty-tree or main-branch STOP. [oracle: bun test test/commands/prune.test.ts]

`cam prune` is registered as a deterministic zero-LLM subcommand: a parsePruneArgs function with null/help guards, a `case 'prune'` in the index.ts dispatch switch, a PRUNE_HELP entry in HELP_REGISTRY, and inclusion in the COMMANDS command-name array, invokable as `cam prune`. [oracle: grep -q "case 'prune'" index.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
The full spine passes green. [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: New handler in src/commands/prune.ts (dep-injected: git spawnFn + optional gh spawnFn, mirroring runNext's parameterized shape and IssueDispatchDeps at index.ts:2313). Register in index.ts: add 'prune' to COMMANDS array (index.ts:2583-2608), add PRUNE_HELP to HELP_REGISTRY (index.ts:2638 map, Record<Command,string> so a missing entry fails typecheck), add parsePruneArgs (follow parseSubcommandArgs idiom at index.ts:1136), and a `case 'prune'` in the dispatch switch (index.ts:2718+). Faithful de-inline of .claude/commands/cam-prune.md: dirty STOP, main-branch STOP, non-cam/* branch confirmation (--force), open-PR confirmation via `gh pr view --json state,mergedAt,url` (--force), then checkout main / pull origin main / git branch -D <branch> / git fetch --prune. NEVER delete main/master, never force-push. Tests must inject fake git/gh spawn fns, never shell out (curated invariant: hit real I/O at wire boundaries but DI-fakes fine for subprocess). noUncheckedIndexedAccess: guard regex/array access.

userStories.title: Add deterministic `cam issue get <id>` subcommand
userStories.description: As the orchestrator, I need `cam issue get <id>` so that reading a single issue JSON from main is a deterministic CLI call instead of an inline `git show` I shell out in several templates.
acceptanceCriteria: `cam issue get <id>` resolves the zero-padded issue filename (CAM-42 -> scripts/cam/issues/CAM-0042.json), reads the issue JSON from main via `git show main:scripts/cam/issues/<PREFIX>-NNNN.json` through an injected git dep, prints it to stdout, and exits nonzero with a clear message when the id does not exist. [oracle: bun test test/commands/issue-get.test.ts]

`cam issue get` is added to the ParsedIssueArgs union (index.ts:1079) and parseIssueArgs subcommand detection (evaluated before the free-text fallthrough, mirroring close/abandon/demote), wired in dispatchIssue (index.ts:2483-2509 sibling case), and surfaced in the ISSUE_HELP and cam issue summary strings. [oracle: grep -q "mode: 'get'" index.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
The full spine passes green. [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Build on existing src/issues/ seams: reuse issueFilePath(id) (src/issues/backlog.ts:205, already does the CAM-42 -> CAM-0042.json padding) for id->filename, and read from main via `git show main:<path>` (injectable spawnSync like readBacklogFromMain's cat-file path at src/issues/backlog.ts:127) instead of re-implementing id parsing. Put the read handler in src/commands/issue-get.ts (dep-injected). Wire: add `{ mode: 'get'; id: string; help: false }` to ParsedIssueArgs union (index.ts:1079-1086), add a `get <id>` branch to parseIssueArgs before the free-text fallthrough (index.ts:1136+, missing-id is a parse error like close/abandon/demote), add a `parsed.mode === 'get'` case to dispatchIssue (index.ts near 2483/2509) with an injectable dep on IssueDispatchDeps, update ISSUE_HELP (index.ts:352). Do NOT hand-file or write any issue file on-branch: get is read-only. noUncheckedIndexedAccess guards on args indexing.

userStories.title: Fold the deterministic preflight into `cam next` as a signal-write gate
userStories.description: As the orchestrator, I need `cam next` to run the git-sync/clean-tree/typecheck/tests preflight itself and gate the active:true write on it, so the checks are deterministic instead of imperative steps I run inline in my session.
acceptanceCriteria: `cam next` runs a deterministic preflight (git sync with remote, clean-tree check, typecheck, tests) before writing active:true, gates the active-signal write on preflight success (a failing preflight returns nonzero and does NOT flip active:true), all driven through injected deps so tests never shell out to real git nor run the real typecheck/test suite. [oracle: bun test test/commands/next-preflight.test.ts]
`cam next --skip-preflight` bypasses the preflight and proceeds directly to the existing signal-write path (the resume escape). [oracle: bun test test/commands/next-preflight.test.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
The full spine passes green. [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Design decision (resolved on merits per issue gotcha): the preflight FOLDS INTO runNext as a gate BEFORE the signal write (src/commands/next.ts:273-395, active:true write at L344-389), NOT a separate subcommand, because cam next is the natural single call the orch makes; --skip-preflight is the resume escape. Only de-inline the imperative preflight from cam-next.md:1-22 (git fetch origin / rev-parse origin/<branch> / pull-or-push, git status clean-tree, bun run typecheck, bun test); do NOT touch the architecture-doc portion of the file. CRITICAL: preflight deps MUST be injectable (add optional fields to NextOptions, follow runNext's already-parameterized shape) so tests never run real typecheck/bun test -- this prevents test recursion (cam next preflight running bun test which runs cam next). Add a --skip-preflight flag to parseNextArgs. Gate placement: run preflight after the liveness/mutex checks, before the stateFilePath active:true write.

userStories.title: De-inline the /cam-prune and /cam-next templates to call the new CLI
userStories.description: As a template maintainer, I need the /cam-prune and /cam-next command templates to replace their inline git and gate steps with a call to the new deterministic CLI subcommands, leaving no orphaned inline steps, so the orchestrator narrates instead of running the logic.
acceptanceCriteria: The /cam-prune template replaces its inline git dance (dirty STOP, checkout main, pull, git branch -D, git fetch --prune) with a call to `cam prune`, and the /cam-next template replaces its inline preflight steps (git sync, clean tree, typecheck, tests) with reliance on `cam next`'s folded preflight, leaving no orphaned inline git/gate steps. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]

The edits are applied to BOTH template trees (.claude/commands/cam-prune.md + .claude/commands/cam-next.md AND templates/commands/cam-prune.md + templates/commands/cam-next.md) and each pair stays byte-identical. [oracle: diff -q .claude/commands/cam-prune.md templates/commands/cam-prune.md && diff -q .claude/commands/cam-next.md templates/commands/cam-next.md]
Vendor drift check passes (bun run embed-vendor:check). [oracle: bun run embed-vendor:check]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
The full spine passes green. [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Depends on US-001, US-002, US-003 (the CLI subcommands must exist before the templates can call them). Dual-copy is VERIFIED byte-identical (issue gotcha): edit .claude/commands/cam-*.md AND templates/commands/cam-*.md identically, then run `bun run embed-vendor` to sync src/vendor/_generated.ts (agent-prompt self-hosting pattern, patterns.md). The templatesContents byte-parity test in test/embedded.test.ts catches drift. cam-next.md: only replace the imperative preflight block (lines ~1-22); keep the architecture doc (thin-proxy dispatch, worker entrypoint, decideNextAction table). cam-prune.md: replace steps 1-7 with a `cam prune` call plus narration of its output; keep the Rules section as narration guidance. This story touches templates/ so embed-vendor:check is mandatory. Commit message should note 'intentional self-hosting' so an auditor does not flag harness drift.
